memory.interpretation: Sum covers successfully observed named Ollama process working sets and can double-count shared pages. Missing values remain null. Available RAM is system-wide; private bytes are commit, not resident memory; process peaks are lifetime values. No cgroup equivalent or GPU-memory use is inferred.
